id: 13_Laboratory Safety Safe Handling and Risks of Cryogenic Liquids Training Course
title: 低温液体：冷得伤人
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/13_Laboratory Safety Safe Handling and Risks of Cryogenic Liquids Training Course.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/13_Laboratory Safety Safe Handling and Risks of Cryogenic Liquids Training Course/src.py

points.K11: 用杜瓦瓶，带泄压阀、松盖
points.K18: 皮鞋皮围裙，不穿运动鞋
points.K20: 沾到皮肤：常温水、慢复温
points.S4: 有人晕倒：别贸然冲进去

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一只液氮罐旁，罐口冒着白雾，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a liquid nitrogen dewar with white vapor drifting from its loose lid and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲低温液体的安全使用。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一个带盖的普通保温杯走向液氮罐
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks toward a liquid nitrogen dewar holding an ordinary screw-cap thermos bottle.
shots.narration: 阿杰想用保温杯装点液氮回去用。

shots.scene: 小研急忙拦住，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hurries over, stops him and shakes her head firmly.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧拦下：这样会出大事！

shots.scene: 液氮罐和普通气瓶图标并排，液氮罐带雪花
shots.prompt_en: A dewar icon with a snowflake next to a regular gas cylinder icon. No people.
shots.narration: 低温液体是特殊的压缩气体，危害自成一类。

shots.scene: 温度计指向极低刻度，旁边是气体分子
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon at a very low mark next to gas molecule icons. No people.
shots.narration: 它极冷，常温下本来是气体。

shots.scene: 开口容器里液体翻滚冒白雾
shots.prompt_en: An open container on a bench with liquid boiling vigorously and thick white vapor rising. No people.
shots.narration: 一离开低温，就会剧烈沸腾。

shots.scene: 雪花图标落在手形图标上，手变成蓝白色
shots.prompt_en: A snowflake icon landing on a hand icon that turns pale blue. No people.
shots.narration: 直接接触，皮肤会冷灼伤，甚至冻伤。

shots.scene: 结霜的管道和罐壁，一只手伸过去被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A frosted pipe and dewar wall, with a bare hand icon reaching toward it crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 结霜的罐子和管道也别徒手碰。

shots.scene: 皮肤粘在冰冷金属上的示意图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of skin stuck to an icy metal surface with small frost crystals. No people.
shots.narration: 冰冷表面会把皮肤牢牢粘住。

shots.scene: 低温液体倒进常温杯子，溅出液滴
shots.prompt_en: An icon of cold liquid poured into a room-temperature cup, with droplets splashing out. No people.
shots.narration: 倒进较热的容器，会沸腾飞溅。

shots.scene: 容器开口处结冰堵住，压力表指针升高
shots.prompt_en: A container opening blocked by an ice plug, with a pressure gauge needle rising into red. No people.
shots.narration: 开口处结冰堵住，压力憋在里面，

shots.scene: 容器图标外出现警示三角和爆裂线
shots.prompt_en: A container icon with a warning triangle and burst lines around it. No people.
shots.narration: 可能引起爆炸。

shots.scene: 液氧罐图标旁，木块和油瓶图标冒火
shots.prompt_en: A liquid oxygen dewar icon next to a wood block icon and an oil bottle icon bursting into flames. No people.
shots.narration: 液氧会让可燃物更容易着火、爆燃。

shots.scene: 液氮间墙上的氧含量报警器亮着绿灯，排风扇转动
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen level monitor glowing green on the wall of a liquid nitrogen room, with an exhaust fan running. No people.
shots.narration: 使用场所要通风，装氧含量报警器。

shots.scene: 小研看一眼报警器读数再进门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student glances at the oxygen monitor display before entering the room.
shots.narration: 用前用中都看一眼，确认正常。

shots.scene: 油污手套和脏抹布靠近液氧罐被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An oily glove and a dirty rag next to a liquid oxygen dewar, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 设备不能沾油脂、油污和灰尘。

shots.scene: 普通塑料管遇冷后碎裂的图标，旁边是专用低温管
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary plastic tube icon cracking in the cold, next to a proper cryogenic hose icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 低温会让材料变脆，要用耐低温的器具。

shots.section_title: 用杜瓦瓶，带泄压阀、松盖
shots.scene: 杜瓦瓶剖面图，夹层是真空
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a dewar showing the inner vessel, the vacuum gap and the outer wall. No people.
shots.narration: 低温液体存放在专用杜瓦瓶里。
overlay: 用杜瓦瓶，带泄压阀、松盖

shots.section_title: 用杜瓦瓶，带泄压阀、松盖
shots.scene: 杜瓦瓶上的泄压阀和松松盖着的盖子
shots.prompt_en: A dewar with a pressure relief valve and a loose-fitting lid letting vapor escape. No people.
shots.narration: 要有泄压阀，盖子松盖，让气体能跑出来。

shots.scene: 老李和阿杰一起推带轮的液氮罐
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the young male student move a wheeled liquid nitrogen dewar together.
shots.narration: 搬运液氮罐，至少两个人。

shots.scene: 水滴图标进入罐口后结成冰，堵住泄压阀
shots.prompt_en: A water droplet icon entering a dewar opening and turning into ice that blocks the relief valve. No people.
shots.narration: 别让水汽进罐子，结冰会堵住泄压阀。

shots.scene: 暖气片、电炉图标远离液氮罐
shots.prompt_en: A radiator icon and a hot plate icon placed far away from a dewar, with a distance arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 热源要远离低温液体。

shots.scene: 小研穿戴好全套防护，站在液氮罐旁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing a face shield, cryogenic gloves, lab coat, leather apron and closed leather shoes stands by a dewar.
shots.narration: 操作低温液体，全程穿戴防护。

shots.scene: 宽松的低温防护手套，手一抖就能甩掉
shots.prompt_en: Loose-fitting cryogenic gloves that slip off easily with a shake of the hand. No people.
shots.narration: 手套要宽松，溅进液体能马上甩掉。

shots.scene: 橡胶手套图标被打叉，旁边是皮手套打勾
shots.prompt_en: A rubber glove icon crossed out, next to a leather glove icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 用皮革或低温专用手套，不用橡胶手套。

shots.scene: 面罩和护目镜贴合脸部的示意
shots.prompt_en: A face shield over close-fitting safety goggles on a head icon. No people.
shots.narration: 戴面罩和护目镜，贴合脸部防渗入。

shots.section_title: 皮鞋皮围裙，不穿运动鞋
shots.scene: 运动鞋被打叉，封闭皮鞋打勾
shots.prompt_en: A mesh sneaker icon crossed out, next to a closed leather shoe icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 穿封闭皮鞋，运动鞋会把液体吸向皮肤。
overlay: 皮鞋皮围裙，不穿运动鞋

shots.section_title: 皮鞋皮围裙，不穿运动鞋
shots.scene: 皮围裙挂在液氮间门口
shots.prompt_en: A leather apron hanging on a hook at the door of a liquid nitrogen room. No people.
shots.narration: 衣服外面再系一条皮围裙。

shots.scene: 戒指和手表图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A ring icon and a wristwatch icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 摘掉戒指、手表等金属饰物。

shots.section_title: 沾到皮肤：常温水、慢复温
shots.scene: 手在常温自来水下冲洗，热水壶和冰块图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A hand under gently running room-temperature tap water; a kettle icon and an ice cube icon are crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 沾到皮肤，用常温水冲，不用热水冷水。
overlay: 沾到皮肤：常温水、慢复温

shots.section_title: 沾到皮肤：常温水、慢复温
shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁是手形图标慢慢恢复颜色
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon beside a hand icon slowly regaining its normal color. No people.
shots.narration: 慢慢复温，不要揉搓。

shots.section_title: 沾到皮肤：常温水、慢复温
shots.scene: 医院图标
shots.prompt_en: A hospital icon with a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 出现冻伤，立即就医。

shots.scene: 小研熟练地按步骤操作，阿杰在旁学习
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carefully follows each step at a dewar while the young male student watches and learns.
shots.narration: 熟悉它、小心它，是最好的防护。

shots.scene: 液氮罐冒出白雾，气体云膨胀充满房间
shots.prompt_en: Vapor from a dewar expanding into a large invisible gas cloud that fills a small room diagram. No people.
shots.narration: 液氮气化体积变大很多，会挤走氧气。

shots.scene: 氧气分子图标越来越少，人形图标晕倒
shots.prompt_en: Oxygen molecule icons dwindling in a room diagram while a person icon faints. No people.
shots.narration: 缺氧看不见、闻不到，人会突然晕倒。

shots.scene: 小研在开着窗、通风良好的房间少量倒液氮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours a small amount of liquid nitrogen in a well-ventilated room with the window open.
shots.narration: 在通风好的地方用，别在小房间大量倒。

shots.scene: 液氮罐独自在电梯里，人在电梯外
shots.prompt_en: A wheeled dewar alone inside an elevator while the facility engineer stands outside pressing the button.
shots.narration: 乘电梯，人罐分离，罐子单独上。

shots.scene: 人和液氮罐同在电梯里的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person and a dewar together inside an elevator, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 电梯一停，缺氧的就是同乘的人。

shots.scene: 保温杯、拧紧的瓶子装液氮图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a screw-cap thermos and a tightly capped bottle filled with liquid nitrogen, both crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能装进保温杯、密封瓶。

shots.scene: 小研把液氮倒进带松盖的小杜瓦瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills a small dewar with a loose lid instead of a thermos.
shots.narration: 只用专用杜瓦瓶，盖子不拧紧。

shots.section_title: 有人晕倒：别贸然冲进去
shots.scene: 门外的人伸手拦住同伴不让进屋，屋里有人晕倒
shots.prompt_en: Outside a room where someone has collapsed near a dewar, the female graduate student holds back the young male student from rushing in.
shots.narration: 看到有人晕倒，别贸然冲进去。
overlay: 有人晕倒：别贸然冲进去

shots.section_title: 有人晕倒：别贸然冲进去
shots.scene: 打开门窗通风、拨打电话的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an open door with airflow, an exhaust fan and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 先通风，呼救，拨打119和120。

shots.section_title: 有人晕倒：别贸然冲进去
shots.scene: 报告链图标：实验室—学院—保卫处
shots.prompt_en: A chain of three icons connected by arrows: a lab, a college building and a security badge. No people.
shots.narration: 并报告实验室负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现雪花、冰堵、火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a snowflake, an ice plug and a flame.
shots.narration: 冻伤、粘皮、飞溅、冻堵、助燃。

shots.scene: 报警器、杜瓦瓶、电梯图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an oxygen monitor, a dewar with a loose lid and an elevator with only a dewar inside. No people.
shots.narration: 通风报警，杜瓦松盖，人罐分离。

shots.scene: 面罩、宽松手套、皮鞋、常温水图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a face shield, loose cryogenic gloves, leather shoes and a running tap. No people.
shots.narration: 全程防护，沾到皮肤用常温水冲。

shots.scene: 欣欣在液氮罐旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a dewar with a loose lid, wearing a small face shield.
shots.narration: 冷静对待低温，安全实验，下次见！
